# 设置人员的电梯楼层配置
##### 简要描述

- URI中的ChannelID表示通道编号，对于IPC来说，ChannelID固定为1

**XML**字段解释<span lang="EN-US"></span>

| <span class="colour" style="color:black">字段</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:black">类型</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:black">解释</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:black">是否必须</span> |
| --- | --- | --- | ---- |
| ChannelID | integer | 通道号，对于IPC来说，ChannelID固定为1 | 否 |
| PersonID | integer | 人员对应的ID号Get的时候，PersonID在URL的请求参数中传参Put的时候，PersonID 在请求体XML中以字段形式传递，由0递增 | 是 |
| Floor | -3,-2,-1,1,2,3,4,5 | 人员有权限的楼层；由楼层数拼接成的字符串，例如：“-3,-2,-1,1,2,3,4,5”，分别表示-3层,-2层,-1层,1层,2层,3层,4层,5层，范围[-128,128] | 否 |

![image.png](data:image/png;base64,)

``` http
PUT /FaceGroup/1/PersonElevatorConfig?PersonID=0 HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46
Content-Type: application/xml
User-Agent: PostmanRuntime/7.42.0
Accept: */*
Cache-Control: no-cache
Postman-Token: d110c35d-cac7-4f50-ae6f-0f229572a4f2
Host: 192.168.6.150
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Connection: keep-alive
Content-Length: 205

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<PersonElevatorFloorInfo Version="1.0">
<ChannelID>1</ChannelID>
<PersonID>0</PersonID>
<Floor>-2,-3,-4,1,2,4,5,8</Floor>
</PersonElevatorFloorInfo>


HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Server: CGI/2.0.5
Content-Type: application/xml
Connection: close
Content-Length: 199

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<ResponseStatus Version="1.0">
<requestURL>/FaceGroup/1/PersonElevatorConfig</requestURL>
<statusCode>0</statusCode>
<message />
</ResponseStatus>
```

PUT HTTP请求示例
PUT /FaceGroup/1/PersonElevatorConfig HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46
Content-Type: application/xml
User-Agent: PostmanRuntime/7.26.10
Accept: _/_
Cache-Control: no-cache
Postman-Token: d7e5cf04-2a97-4b87-801a-38bfcc240c0a
Host: 192.168.1.100
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Connection: keep-alive
Content-Length: 124

\<PersonElevatorFloorInfo>
\<PersonID>2\</PersonID>
\<Floor>-2,1,5,6\</Floor>
\</PersonElevatorFloorInfo>

PUT HTTP响应示例
HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Server: CGI/2.0.0
Content-Type: application/xml
Connection: close
Content-Length: 191

\<ResponseStatus Version="1.0">
\<requestURL>/FaceGroup/1/PersonElevatorConfig\</requestURL>
\<statusCode>0\</statusCode>
\<message>none\</message>
\</ResponseStatus>

##### 请求URL

 - `/FaceGroup/ChannelID/PersonElevatorConfig?PersonID=xx` 

##### 请求方式

- put
 
##### 成功返回示例  
```
{}

```
